visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three individuals—a woman on the left in a grey checkered blouse, a man in the center wearing a black t-shirt and glasses, and a man on the right in a dark vest—sit behind a grey table. Behind them is a shelf filled with various snack packages, and a grey concrete-textured wall features the text 'THE DODO MEN' with a lightning bolt logo. The lighting is bright and even studio lighting. (2) A full-screen yellow background appears with bold black text '挑戰開始！' centered on the screen. (3) The camera returns to the trio who are now leaning forward on the table. The man in the center and the man on the right both have their hands clasped under their chins, looking intently toward the camera. Large text overlays appear at the bottom of the frame in white with black outlines. (4) The scene cuts to a different indoor office environment where a man in a green and white striped shirt stands behind a wooden shelf, smiling and looking toward the left of the frame. (5) Back to the trio, the man on the right is now laughing heartily, covering his mouth with his hand, while the woman and the center man also smile and lean towards each other. (6) A sequence of quick cuts shows various high-energy reactions; the man on the right stands up and picks up a small black stool in excitement while the others cheer. (7) The video concludes with the three individuals sitting together again, giving thumbs-up gestures and waving at the camera as the frame freezes and fades.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched, energetic female and male voices introduce the challenge over a bright, rhythmic electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat. A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals a transition. (2) A 'ding' SFX occurs as a quiz question is read. Vocal arousal increases significantly with rapid-fire speech and sharp laughter as the participants shout answers. (3) A loud 'pop' SFX accompanies the appearance of variety-show text on screen. The BGM remains consistent in tempo but feels busier with added percussive hits. (4) Multiple voices overlap as everyone laughs and reacts to a wrong answer; high vocal pitch variability and intense loudness are noted. (5) A final cheer from the group with high vocal valence and a 'stinger' musical phrase marks the conclusion of the main segment, followed by a softer conversational tone.
